definitions.explanation: Describes a relaxed, unhurried state of mind or manner, especially remaining calm and unperturbed regardless of circumstances. Often implies a dignified ease.

examples.japanese: {悠然|ゆうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悠然|ゆうぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: He answered with a calm, composed demeanor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{騒|さわ}いで→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悠然|ゆうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even as those around her were making a fuss, she calmly continued reading.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective/adverb. Most commonly used adverbially as {悠然|ゆうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {悠然|ゆうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (calmly, leisurely, composedly)

NUANCE: {悠然|ゆうぜん} suggests an elegant, dignified calmness with an unhurried quality. It implies being above petty concerns and maintaining composure with grace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悠然|ゆうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to remain unruffled)
- {悠然|ゆうぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (composed demeanor)
- {悠然|ゆうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk leisurely)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{泰然|たいぜん}→泰然：09173_taizen⟧ (calm, unperturbed - similar but emphasizes steadfastness)
- ⟦{悠々|ゆうゆう}→悠々：04010_yuuyuu⟧ (leisurely, at ease)
- ⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧ (calm, composed)
